name: Gasthof Köllenspitze
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthof Köllenspitze in Nesselwängle**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, **Gasthof Köllenspitze** invites you to experience authentic alpine hospitality in the picturesque village of **Nesselwängle**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy retreat offers breathtaking views of the **Lechquellengebirge** mountains and the serene **Weggissee** lake.

Our rustic yet charming guesthouse blends traditional Tyrolean warmth with modern comforts. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the stunning **Lechtal** valley, unwind in our sunlit lounge or by the crackling fireplace. Savor hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, or fresh trout from the nearby rivers, paired with local **Tiroler** wines and craft beers.

Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, **Gasthof Köllenspitze** promises an unforgettable escape in one of **Tirol**’s most idyllic corners. **Willkommen im Lechtal!**
